title: Cover
description: The front cover of one issue (production/issues/<ISS_ID>/cover/cover.yaml): one image with its concept, the characters and props it shows, the exact cover lettering, and the approval state. compile-prompts.js --cover compiles it; renders and reviews sit beside it like a page's.

id.description: Cover ID: CV_<issue number>, e.g. CV_001 for ISS_001.

concept.description: The one image the cover shows, as a drawable moment.

composition.description: Framing and placement notes, including where the title sits.

location.description: Location shown, or null for a cover with no setting.

time_of_day.description: Time of day of the setting.

cast.description: Characters drawn on the cover, once each. May be empty.

wardrobe.description: Outfit drawn. Default: the character's default_wardrobe.

state.description: Physical state tags visible on the cover.

props.description: Props in view that nobody holds.

lettering.description: The exact text of the cover.

mode.description: in_image: the model letters the cover. overlay: the art stays free of text and the title is added afterwards. Default: project.lettering.mode.

issue_line.description: Exact words of the issue line (number, issue title), or null.

tagline.description: Exact words of the tagline, or null.

credits.description: Exact words of the credit line, or null.

status.description: draft: no render chosen yet. approved: approved_render is the cover that ships.

approved_render.description: The approved cover render, or null while the cover is a draft. Approval needs a review with verdict pass or fixed.

notes.description: Free-form notes for people. Never read by scripts.
